OR VIDEO
EVERYSTUDENT.INFO
And here’s the best part: you don’t have to send
someone to a website they may never go to anyway.
Every article and video at EveryStudent.com can
be e-mailed with a single click to a friend or family
member. “In light of our conversation yesterday, I
thought you might find this article interesting or
helpful.” That’s it; that’s all you’d need to say along
with the attached article or video—couldn’t get an
easier to share the truth, love, and hope of Jesus
Christ.
It’s hard to know what life was like before Shoebox
greeting cards. Where the traditional line of Hallmark
card was odd, old, clunky, and corny: Shoebox was
clever, personal, relevant, and tailored to the many,
many nuances of life.
This is perhaps the simplest way to make sure that
those you know and care about have an opportunity
to know Christ. For quick instructions on sending an
article or video go to: EveryStudent.info
EveryStudent.com is to the gospel what Shoebox
Greetings is to greeting cards. In the course of your
conversations questions arise concerning: life, God,
significance, purpose, suffering, relationships, sex,
drugs, etc., etc. At EveryStudent.com you’ll find short,
insightful treatments on most any subject germane to
life. These articles address the issue, shed light on the
question, and make relevant connections to God and
the gospel.
